ftc-value.question: Use the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus to find $\int_0^3 x^2\,dx$.
ftc-value.explanation: $F(x)=\dfrac{x^3}{3}$ is an antiderivative of $x^2$, so the integral is $F(3)-F(0)=9-0=9$. A left sum with 6 pieces is only $6.875$, below 9 because $x^2$ is increasing. More pieces bring the sums closer to 9.
